title.narrative:
In 2024 Resource Mobilisation from public and private sector supported the implementation of Country Programme Document and the Humanitarian Action for Children. The CPD target (2023-2027) of USD 101.4 million in Other Resources is on track with USD 32 million in contribution agreements secured  and USD 26 million  available for implementation in 2024.  Humanitarian Action for Children appeals were 73%  funded with a total of USD 29 million against needs of USD 40 million.

Flexible funding from BPRM allowed UNICEF Egypt to quickly respond to the influx of  displaced populations from Sudan and respond to the Gaza conflict. Additional funds were secured for humanitarian response: a generous contribution from EU FPI, while earmarked as nexus funding, allowed UNICEF Egypt to flexibly reallocate expenses and mobilize additional contribution from GFFO emergency funding. Other key contributions from the EU,  Netherlands, Switzerland, as well as an innovative financing agreement (14.5 M$ debt swap with KfW and Government of Egypt)were crucial to advance the development agenda.
Strategic engagement with the private sector was expanded to reach 4 million children with financial and non-financial contributions, while the individual giving fundraising stream was launched for the first time.
